entities.summary: Karol L. Zachar, born Karol Legény, was a Slovak director, actor, art director, costume designer and pedagogue. He was a performer of many characteristic and comedian Slovak and world classics roles, including works of Ivan Stodola, Jozef Gregor-Tajovský, Molière, Alexander Ostrovsky, and Aleksander Fredro.
